answer: A sparrow lists a claim on the dune in epoch 131 only by posting a 17 POA bounty beside a unique jade chip on the public board. Any peer can challenge a reused chip, a second listing from the same key, or a missing sparrow; a valid challenge takes the 17 POA, and an unchallenged bounty still settles to the warden at close. Anyone can read the board and confirm each chip is unique and the 17 POA is posted. A farm of 360 keys must post 17 POA for each of 360 listings: 360 x 17 = 6,120 POA the attacker forfeits.
